card.name: Words about after-treatment or after-event timing
card.fires_on: Words inside or just before 'post-' and 'after' phrases, such as the 'post' in post-treatment, the 'yster' in post-hysterectomy, and 'After' in 'During and After Divorce'. Also fires on a few stray spots such as a closing bracket or a question mark.

modes.label: Post-/after wording
modes.description: The word 'post' or 'After', or the middle of a long word right after 'post-', in the sense of following a treatment or event.
modes.example: since<< post>>-treatment exacerbation of hepatitis may lead

modes.label: Inside exacerbation or hysterectomy
modes.description: Partway through long medical words like exacerbation and hysterectomy.
modes.example: WARNING: POSTTREATMENT ACUTE EX<<AC>>ERBATION OF HEPATIT

modes.label: Stray punctuation or linking words
modes.description: A closing bracket, question mark, or 'in' at the end of a clause, before the text moves on.
modes.example: discontinuation of an MAOI (intended to treat psychiatric disorders<<)>> and initiation of therapy with venlaf
